title: Organizing a Potluck Lunch
context: Molly 和同事 Dan 为团队自带菜午餐分配食物和用品，避免大家带同一种东西。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Our team potluck is on Friday. Have you decided what to bring?
dialogue.zh: 我们的团队自带菜午餐在周五。你决定带什么了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I was thinking of a bean salad. Is anyone else bringing one?
dialogue.zh: 我在想带一份豆子沙拉。还有别人带这个吗？

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Let me check the list. So far we have bread and fruit.
dialogue.zh: 我看看清单。目前有面包和水果。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Then the salad should add something different.
dialogue.zh: 那沙拉应该能增加一种不同的选择。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: That sounds good. I can bring a big bowl of rice.
dialogue.zh: 听起来不错。我可以带一大碗米饭。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Do we have serving spoons, or should I bring some?
dialogue.zh: 我们有分菜勺吗，还是我带几个？

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Please bring two if you can. I will bring plates and napkins.
dialogue.zh: 如果可以，请带两个。我来带盘子和餐巾。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Sure. Where should we put everything when we arrive?
dialogue.zh: 好。我们到了以后把东西放在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: The table by the window has space for the dishes.
dialogue.zh: 窗边的桌子有地方放菜。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I can get there a little early and help set it up.
dialogue.zh: 我可以早一点到，帮忙布置。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Thanks. I will update the list so everyone can see our plans.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我会更新清单，让大家都看到我们的安排。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Great. I am looking forward to lunch with the team.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我很期待和团队一起吃午饭。

expressions.zh: 自带菜聚餐，参加者各带食物分享。
expressions.example: Our office is having a potluck next week.
So far, three people have signed up.
A vegetable dish would add something different.

expressions.zh: 分菜勺，用于给大家盛取食物。
expressions.example: Please put a serving spoon beside the rice.
We can set up the table before the guests arrive.

pronunciation: potluck 重音在第一个音节 POT；spoon 以 /sp/ 开头，注意不要在 s 前加元音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Shared meals
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy sharing meals with coworkers or classmates?
practice.answer: Yes. It gives us time to talk about things outside work, and everyone can contribute something they enjoy.

practice.title: Part 2 · A shared meal
practice.prompt: Describe a meal where everyone contributed something. Say who was there, what people brought, and what made it enjoyable.
practice.answer: My coworkers and I once arranged a shared lunch in our office. We made a list so that people could bring different dishes and supplies. I brought a bowl of rice, and another coworker brought a bean salad. Two people arrived early to arrange the table and put out plates. We tried a little of everything and talked during the break. It felt friendly and easy to organize together. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Group planning
practice.prompt: What helps a group organize a meal successfully?
practice.answer: A shared list makes it easier to see what is still needed. Clear responsibilities also prevent one person from doing all the work.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读分配食物和用品的句子，再提出你愿意为聚餐带的东西。
practice.answer: I can bring a salad. Is anyone bringing serving spoons? I can arrive early to help set up the table.
